tweet.text:
OpenCode published an official statement regarding a recent distillation attack. 

> Earlier today, OpenAI, Anthropic and Google balances of some OpenCode users got drained. 

> Reportedly, only 1.4% of users were affected and these users were notified via an email. 

This is a serious precedent because if this distillation vector is the simplest to execute, that means that major AI labs are now much more protected than they were earlier. This also means that using smaller providers is now less safe. 

Additionally, tokens from leading AI labs now have a higher value since they are harder to get for distillation. 

A wild AI west 👀

quote.text:
We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users

We have notified them all this morning via email. If you did not get an email you were not impacted, it was a subset of users who had external providers linked

The incident is ongoing so we cannot share more details at this point but we are working with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to remediate
